Interface ProgressionCostFactory

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
RepeatedNodeHeuristic.Factory, RepeatedRootHeuristic.Factory, WeightedCost.Factory
public interface ProgressionCostFactory extends Serializable
A factory object that creates progression cost objects. Progression cost factories allow a planner to produce different cost objects for each new problem in case the cost function needs to do any pre-processing based on the problem.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware

    • getCost

      ProgressionCost getCost(CompiledProblem problem, Worker.Status status)
      Creates a progression cost object to be used while solving the given problem.
      Parameters:
      problem - the problem that will be solved by the search that uses the cost object made by this method
      status - a status to update while the cost object is created
      Returns:
      a progression cost object that can be used to evaluate nodes in a search to solve the given problem
